candidates.name: WINHTTP_ASYNC_RESULT
verified_facts: Carries asynchronous WinHTTP API and error information for request-error notifications.
semantic_limits: An asynchronous error record identifies an API failure but does not by itself identify root cause, endpoint, process ownership, or recovery success.

candidates.name: WinHttpGetProxyForUrl
verified_facts: Resolves proxy information for a URL using explicit auto-proxy options and returns proxy and bypass data.
semantic_limits: Proxy resolution may use cached PAC, WPAD, DNS, DHCP, or credentials and does not prove the proxy used by a later request.

candidates.name: WinHttpGetProxyForUrlEx
verified_facts: Starts asynchronous proxy resolution for a URL using a proxy-resolver handle created from an asynchronous WinHTTP session.
semantic_limits: Starting proxy resolution only yields pending work; callback completion, result extraction, error status, and exact request application are required.

candidates.name: WinHttpGetIEProxyConfigForCurrentUser
verified_facts: Retrieves the current user's Internet Explorer or WinINet proxy and auto-configuration settings.
semantic_limits: Current-user settings may not apply to service, scheduled-task, system, or explicitly configured WinHTTP contexts.

candidates.name: WinHttpGetDefaultProxyConfiguration
verified_facts: Retrieves the default WinHTTP proxy configuration.
semantic_limits: Default proxy configuration is global configuration metadata and does not prove which proxy an individual request actually used.

candidates.name: WINHTTP_AUTOPROXY_OPTIONS
verified_facts: Defines PAC URL, auto-detection, and authentication behavior used by proxy resolution.
semantic_limits: Auto-proxy options describe requested discovery behavior; they do not prove PAC integrity, discovery source, selected proxy, or request routing.

candidates.name: WINHTTP_PROXY_INFO
verified_facts: Contains access type, proxy list, and bypass list for WinHTTP configuration.
semantic_limits: Proxy strings can contain multiple entries and bypass patterns; they require normalization and exact request-option readback.

candidates.name: WINHTTP_CURRENT_USER_IE_PROXY_CONFIG
verified_facts: Contains current-user automatic detection, PAC URL, proxy, and bypass settings.
semantic_limits: The structure reflects user configuration only and may contain null or dynamically allocated strings; it is not proof of runtime use.

candidates.name: WINHTTP_PROXY_RESULT
verified_facts: Contains an ordered set of extended proxy resolution entries.
semantic_limits: The returned list is a resolution result, not proof that a connection succeeded through any entry or that failover order was followed.

candidates.name: WINHTTP_PROXY_RESULT_ENTRY
verified_facts: Describes one proxy result entry including proxy, bypass, scheme, and port information.
semantic_limits: A single entry is only one candidate route and does not authenticate the proxy or establish that it carried the observed response.

candidates.name: WinHttpCrackUrl
verified_facts: Separates a URL into scheme, host, port, path, and extra-info components.
semantic_limits: URL parsing does not perform canonical DNS, IDN, proxy, redirect, or endpoint validation and must not be treated as connection identity.

candidates.name: URL_COMPONENTS
verified_facts: Defines component pointers and lengths used to parse or construct URLs.
semantic_limits: Component buffers and lengths require strict initialization and bounds handling; equivalent textual URLs can still resolve or route differently.

candidates.name: WinHttpCreateUrl
verified_facts: Constructs a URL string from URL component values.
semantic_limits: Constructed URL text does not prove canonicalization, DNS resolution, transport security, redirect destination, or server identity.

candidates.name: WinHttpQueryAuthSchemes
verified_facts: Reports authentication schemes advertised by a server or proxy after an authentication challenge.
semantic_limits: Advertised schemes are peer-controlled and do not prove credentials were accepted, confidentiality was established, or the peer is trusted.

candidates.name: WinHttpSetCredentials
verified_facts: Supplies credentials for a server or proxy authentication target and scheme.
semantic_limits: Credentials were not supplied or changed; documentation is retained only to define authentication-state boundaries and sensitive-data risk.

candidates.name: WinHttpCreateProxyResolver
verified_facts: Creates a proxy-resolver handle from an asynchronous WinHTTP session for extended proxy resolution.
semantic_limits: A resolver handle is lifecycle state only and does not prove proxy discovery completed, a route was selected, or a request used that route.

candidates.name: WinHttpFreeProxyResult
verified_facts: Frees allocations contained in an extended WinHTTP proxy result.
semantic_limits: Freeing a result is lifecycle hygiene and does not prove the result was valid, applied, or associated with the canonical request.
